type API1 struct{}
type AccessRule struct { Path []AccessStep ReadOnly bool WriteOnly bool }
type AccessStep struct { // Pattern is an _accessPattern step's key test, one of the package's // compiled patterns. Pattern *Pattern Name string // Except and ExceptPatterns are what an _accessOther step steps past: the // members the same schema object declares by name and by pattern, which are // exactly the ones additionalProperties and unevaluatedProperties do not // reach. Except []string ExceptPatterns []*Pattern Kind int Index int }
type Anchor struct { Node *Node Name string }
type At[T any] func(*T, *Doc, Span) error
type Capability struct { Mode string RuntimeFeatures []Feature Unsupported []Feature ResourceCount int RequiresRuntime bool }
type Const struct { // contains filtered or unexported fields }
type DateTime time.Time
type Dependency struct { Key string Keys []string }
type Doc struct { // contains filtered or unexported fields }
type DynamicRef struct { Fallback *Node Anchor string }
type Enc[T any] func(T, []byte) ([]byte, error)

type EvalWhy struct { // contains filtered or unexported fields }
type Feature string
type ID struct { // contains filtered or unexported fields }
type IDArray struct { // contains filtered or unexported fields }

type IDObject struct { // contains filtered or unexported fields }

type IPv6Addr netip.Addr

type Lazy struct { // contains filtered or unexported fields }
type Member struct { Key string Node Node }
type MemberEnc func(idx int, key string, b []byte) ([]byte, error)
type Node struct { Boolean *bool // a bare true/false schema // Const, Enum and UniqueItems compare values as JSON, which is the one part // of the evaluator that needs the identity of a value (see jsonIDJSON); a // package whose nodes state none of the three carries neither the fields // nor the arms that read them. Const *string // JSON encoding of the const value // The numeric keywords, each as the literal the schema wrote. They are // judged through the exact core against the instance's own literal, which // jsonDecodeNumbers keeps; a float64 here gave 9007199254740993 and // 9007199254740992 one reading, and 0.3 no multiple of 0.1. MultipleOf *string Minimum *string Maximum *string ExclusiveMinimum *string ExclusiveMaximum *string MinLength *int MaxLength *int // Pattern is one of the package's compiled patterns, shared with every // other check that states the same one. Pattern *Pattern // Format is set only where the schema's own dialect asserts "format" and // this generator has a check for the name; on a dialect that annotates it, // and for a format nothing here judges, the node carries no field, because // there is nothing to judge rather than something skipped. Format *string // The content vocabulary, on the one dialect that asserts it. Set under the // same rule as Format: present only where a check is going to be made. ContentEncoding *string ContentMediaType *string Items *Node // items as a single schema: applies past the tuple Contains *Node MinContains *int MaxContains *int MinItems *int MaxItems *int AdditionalProperties *Node PropertyNames *Node MinProperties *int MaxProperties *int Not *Node If *Node Then *Node Else *Node UnevaluatedItems *Node UnevaluatedProperties *Node // Ref evaluates another node in place of this one, and is how a schema that // contains itself is expressed: an object whose additionalProperties are // objects of the same shape is a cycle, and a cycle is not a tree of // composite literals. Go refuses a cycle between package-level variable // initialisers, so the nodes taking part in one are declared empty and // assigned in init(). Ref *Node // DynamicRef is a $dynamicRef or $recursiveRef, and is another conjunct like // AllOf: the drafts that define these keywords are the drafts where a // reference applies beside its siblings rather than replacing them. DynamicRef *DynamicRef Type []string // the JSON types the value may have; empty means any Enum []string // JSON encodings of the permitted values PrefixItems []Node // tuple positions (prefixItems, or draft-2019 tuple-form items) Properties []Member // by property name PatternProperties []PatternMember // by ECMA-262 pattern over the key Required []string DependentRequired []Dependency DependentSchemas []Member AllOf []Node AnyOf []Node OneOf []Node // DynamicAnchors marks this node as *entering* a schema resource and lists // what that resource contributes to the dynamic scope while it is being // evaluated. Entering is not the same as being the resource's root: a // reference into the middle of a resource enters it too, and the frame then // hangs off the node the reference landed on. Only the anchors some // reference in this schema searches for are listed; an anchor nothing looks // up changes no answer. DynamicAnchors []Anchor UniqueItems bool // StrictInteger reads "integer" off the instance's token, as draft 3 and // draft 4 do: 1.0 is a number there and not an integer. Every later draft // reads the value. StrictInteger bool }
type NullRule struct { Elem *NullRule Reject bool IsMap bool }
type Number json.Number

type PatternMember struct { Pattern *Pattern Node Node }
